content.text: {"headline":"Approve R2: keep overtime on general (25 agents 10:15-12:15, 22 agents 12:15-14:15) and widen chat deflection to both queues. Predicted service level is 88.9% for 10:15-14:45 against the 80% target, at an extra cost of ₹17,508.","why":"The 09:00 personal loan email (MKT-2026-551) is driving extra calls on general: 307 calls against 236 forecast over the last four intervals, mostly loan and new-offer enquiries. Service level has already fallen to 68%. This is a demand problem, not a staffing problem. Doing nothing would leave the window at 50% (general 38.4%) with 12.3% abandons. R2 lifts the window to 88.9%, with general at 88.3% and payments at 89.6%. Abandons drop to 2.6% and the rest of the day reaches 92.6%. It is the cheapest option that meets the target with no policy issues. It also drops the break delay, so agents get their breaks on time.","trade_offs":["The cheaper options all miss the 80% target. P3 (₹14,868) reaches 77.9%, P4 (₹9,720) reaches 70.1%, and P1 and P2 (₹0 and ₹468) reach only 45.6-49.0%.","R1 performs almost the same (88.8%, 2.5% abandons) but costs ₹180 more (₹17,688). Its overtime blocks overlap, which needs more scheduling.","Payments is protected under R2 at 89.6%, compared with 76.3% under P3. Widening chat deflection to payments enquiries keeps the overtime on general from leaving payments short."],"watch":"Check by 10:45 that the overtime has been taken up close to the 25 agents planned and that chat deflection is reaching about 20% of the targeted enquiries. If campaign calls keep climbing above the current pattern, or general stays below 80% after the first hour, reassess. Plan for the 12:15 overtime handover of 22 agents."}
